title: Ankhorage Graph
summary: Provides a canonical generic directed graph model and deterministic graph algorithms.
purpose: Give packages a reusable graph boundary without coupling graph data or algorithms to rendering, project detection, or provider APIs.
responsibilities: Define generic directed graph data and deterministic graph algorithms.
Expose graph operations for compatible external consumers.
boundaries: Does not depend on Cytoscape, project detection, package managers, GitHub, dependency analysis, or rendering concerns.
Does not own application-specific graph semantics.
audience: Packages and applications that need portable directed graph data and algorithms.
useCases: Model and analyze directed graph relationships independently of a UI or provider.

architecture.role: Portable directed-graph model and algorithm library.
invariants: The package remains independent of rendering and provider technology.

limitations: Application-specific graph meaning belongs to the consuming package.
